A [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] '''clan''' had criminal enforcer [[Grimorg]], who worked for [[Stenness Node]]-based [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Bogga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], as a member. As of [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], Grimorg had convinced several other fellow clan members to also work for Bogga.
